subject: ParcelForge — developer demo request (docs CTA)
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir@parcelforge.io>
To: docs@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:38 -0700
Subject: Developer demo request: embeddings + low-latency streaming

Hi Redwood team,

I clicked the quickstart CTA from your docs and wanted to see if we could book a short technical demo focused on embeddings and streaming latency. We're evaluating options to replace a legacy embeddings pipeline and saw your docs/examples — looks promising.

Prefer afternoons PST next week (Tue/Thu after 1pm PST are best). We'll want a 30–40 minute session with an engineer that can speak to private deployment options and data retention (we have HIPAA-adjacent workloads).

A bit about us: ParcelForge (YC S21) — we do routing and tracking for logistics; we ingest high-volume HTTP traces and lookups that need low per-token cost.

Thanks — happy to share a short sample payload in a follow-up.

– Samir Rao
Head of AI, ParcelForge
samir@parcelforge.io

Hi Samir — thanks for reaching out and for clicking through the docs CTA. I'm Vivek on the solutions team — happy to get you a focused technical walkthrough.

Quick options: 30-minute slot with an engineer (recommended):
- Tue 7/20 1:30pm–2:00pm PT
- Thu 7/22 2:00pm–2:30pm PT
- Thu 7/22 4:00pm–4:30pm PT

If none of those work, pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/vivek-30m-tech-demo

I've CC'd Soojin, one of our solutions engineers, who will lead the demo and can cover private deployment and retention controls in detail. Attached is a short agenda so we can target the right depth.

Agenda (attached: tech-demo-agenda.pdf):
- 5m intros + architecture overview
- 15–20m demo: embeddings integration + streaming example
- 5–10m ops: retention, private deployment, quantization options
- Q&A / next steps

If you can, please reply with 1–2 sample request shapes (or a small example payload) so Soojin can prep.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Solutions, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

- How Redwood handles prefix caching for high QPS lookups
- Private (VPC) deployment options & KMS integration
- Typical end-to-end latency numbers for 512-token responses with batching enabled

I've attached our availability ICS in case that's easier to drop into a shared calendar. We'll have our lead systems engineer, Priya (copied separately from our org), on the call.

Hi Samir — looking forward to Thu 7/22 2:00pm PT. Quick note from the engineering side:

- I'll prepare a short demo showing embeddings ingestion (with a sample Python snippet), streaming under load, and how KV/prefix caching impacts latency.
- For private deployment: I'll show our VPC onboarding checklist and how KMS/HSM keys are integrated.
- If you can send 1–2 example requests (JSON with typical sequence lengths) that would be super helpful — you can paste them inline or send a short file.

Example of what helps: the average token length and whether you use streaming for partial responses vs. full-response generation.

Thanks — see you Thu.
